payload.claim: The spec states two different dates for what reads as the same fact about the currently running builder: the Problem section says the builder (holding 68.1 GB on 2026-11-10) has been "running since 2026-10-24", while the Notes-for-the-agent Measured paragraph says "the builder now running was created at 2026-10-23T17:01:55Z" and ties the same 68.1 GB figure to it.
